reports.title: Tooling Engagement Report for ZKsync Airbender
reports.description: Veridise tooling-based security assessment (February to April 2026) of the ZKsync Airbender RISC-V zkVM prover at commit 5ecb674, combining Picus/LLZK determinism checks of selected constraint-system circuits, fuzzing of the transpiler VM and unrolled prover stages, and targeted manual review of the full-statement verifiers. Three Critical issues (an underconstrained jump/branch/SLT circuit and two verifier-composition flaws) were fixed in pull requests #212 and #258; one Low and two Warnings were acknowledged.
